Hi Elena / Finance team,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — really excited to get Brightline's renewal and capacity top-up finalized. Per our call, summary and ask below: 

- Committed capacity: 300k tokens/month baseline, with a +2x burst window for Q3 launch.
- Term: 12 months starting 2026-06-01.
- Pricing/quote: attached (Renewal_Quote_Redwood_2026.pdf).
- Billing: Brightline requested Net45 on the new term; please confirm. If Net45 is approved we will mark the invoice terms on the renewal.
- Required from you to complete billing: purchase order (PO), billing contact (name + email), and current W-9 or tax form for the paying entity.

Attachments: Renewal_Quote_Redwood_2026.pdf, SOW_Brightline_Q2.pdf

Next steps: If you can email a PO and the billing contact by end of week, Marissa (cc'd) will issue the first invoice the first week of June and route it according to your PO. If Net45 is not approved, we can do a monthly invoice cadence to smooth cashflow — happy to discuss.

Thanks,

1) Net terms: Our procurement policy requires Net45 for any contract >$50k ARR, so Net45 should be fine. Can you confirm Redwood is OK marking invoices Net45 on the renewal?
2) Billing entity: We pay from Brightline Systems, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789). Please send any W-9 or tax documents to finance@brightline.io so we can reconcile.
3) PO timing: Procurement will issue a PO but needs the exact billing contact and invoice recipient name. Can you confirm the invoice should be addressed to: Brightline Systems, Inc. — Accounts Payable, 400 Harbor Way, San Francisco, CA 94105?

We should be able to issue a PO early next week. I'll loop in Jake from procurement if there are questions about the PO format.

Best,
